title: Rash-Free Organic Sanitary Pads - All Regular, With Disposable Bags

details.description: The Azah rash-free period promise. Our Azah Pads are made with the finest organic cotton, so soft you won't even notice you are wearing a pad. It is India’s first made safe certified pad tested to be free from all harmful chemicals by Safe Cosmetics Australia. 96% of the women who use Azah Sanitary Pads reported complete relief from rashes and safe periods. Its hypoallergenic and extra-soft surface is made with the finest organic cotton which prevents irritation to the skin. details.usageInstructions:
Stick the pad in your underwear.
Change your pad every few hours, or when it's soaked with the extra flow.
 It has a shelf life of 3 years. Storage Instructions: Best to be stored in a cool and dry place, away from direct sunlight and heat.

details.description: Azah Menstrual Cup provides you with full period comfort for up to 10 hours in the most contemporary and leak-proof manner. It is a reusable silicone cup which is worn inside the vagina and collects the menstrual flow, instead of absorbing it, thus making it odour & rash free. One cup can last up to 10 years, making it an affordable choice for dealing with periods. Azah Menstrual Cup can be used for up to 10 hours at a stretch and with the ring design, it becomes easier to insert and remove during periods. It is perfect for people who care for their health and want to look out for the environment as well.
details.usageInstructions:
Apply water on the rim of the menstrual cup for lubrication, then simply fold the cup into a C-fold, push down fold, etc and insert it.
Once the menstrual cup is in your vagina, rotate it. It will spring open to create an airtight seal.
Please ensure to sterilize your cup after every cycle.
Storage Instructions: Best to be stored at room temperature, away from direct sunlight and heat.
